science: Root read actual final harmonic source, tensor oracle, independent harmonic/mean BVP, grader, validator, reports, AUTHOR and Physics peer. Root independently derived mean balance nu0*Uprime+Nxy=<uv>. Source retains exact linear viscoelastic flow, wall expansion and all r1 fluid convection, but extends laboratory linear polymer stress to a quadratic mean observable.
public_input_review: Hookean-dumbbell Oldroyd-B liquid with known fractions/relaxation, anchored extensible sheet, no slip, full momentum balance, no imposed pressure gradient or distant shear/counterflow, lab-frame readouts, phase, units and order of limits specify the experiment. No correction formula or solver mandate. Exact unrestricted instruction and unfinished fit; private files excluded.
calibration_review: 288 records at 48 signed harmonic settings with fixed sigma .002. Source and oracle coincide exactly. Two distinct heights identify s through their complex amplitude ratio, with phase bound .68851<pi eliminating aliases and uniquely identifying viscosity.
grading_review: All 256 oracle noise draws pass and all sources fail three pumping groups while passing anchors. Maximum oracle error .0003004, minimum source error4.06845 at ordinary .04 gate. Minimum scored pumping .59739. BVP versus oracle error4.50e-9 and refinement2.20e-9; energy, momentum, Newtonian/creeping, reversal and global calibration checks pass. Local oracle7/7 and source4+3.
classification_caveat: Retaining linear polymer closure after calibration can establish a physical failure. Deriving nonlinear polymer transport but miscoding tensor factors, signs or boundary conditions is a mathematical, numerical or mixed failure. Review the complete public trajectory.
reference_scope: Independent spatial BVP and local mean forcing share constitutive tensor kinematics. Published creeping and conservation checks complement that limited independence. Preserved prototype history contains one explicit NaN development report; current source and reports are finite.
overlap: Same-family substantive revision of archived Newtonian r1 (2/3 passes), retaining its missing convection. Related Hookean and FENE constitutive themes are acknowledged; no new-family claim.
